title: Sweep the sampling temperature
summary: Sweep the temperature on fixed logits, measure entropy and top 1 probability, find where entropy crosses 2 bits, and count the tokens top p keeps.

mutants.bisection_swapped: Moves hi up when the entropy is too low, so the bisection runs to the wrong end.
mutants.log_of_zero: Takes log2 of every probability, so a zero probability gives NaN.
mutants.multiply_temperature: Multiplies the logits by the temperature, not divides, so a higher temperature makes the distribution sharper.
mutants.natural_log: Uses the natural log, so the entropy is in nats, not in bits.
mutants.no_max_shift: Calls np.exp on the scaled logits without the maximum shift, so large logits overflow.
mutants.strict_top_p: Uses a strict greater than, so a cumulative sum equal to p does not stop the prefix.
